title: Signature 24 · Hourglass SSBBW · Dancheong · Palace Eaves
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her early 40s, sleek center-parted low bun with a gold binyeo.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Korean dancheong body painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Glossy celadon green, vermilion, cobalt blue, and golden yellow in the style of palace eave painting, large layered lotus medallions and continuous cloud scrolls. The lotus medallions spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal in a wide stance, arms relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear: Extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, vermilion with celadon tips.

Background & Lighting: Beneath the eaves of a Korean royal palace hall, painted dancheong rafters and red columns softly out of focus, warm daylight glowing beyond, the background much lighter than her body, warm bounce light carving the deep inward curve of the waist and the huge curves of the bust and hips, making the glossy colors gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
